description: The remainder of the nth Perrin number divided by n. A prime n divides R(n), so the remainder is 0. n runs from 1 to 8192. Past 15 digits the Perrin number is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/perrin-divide
